identity.name: Payload
identity.mission: The Command Center for Business Universe
identity.aesthetic: Military Space Command / Sci-Fi HUD / High-Tech Exclusive

typography.import_instructions: Add this to index.html or CSS: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Rajdhani:wght@500;600;700&display=swap');

usage_rules.headings: Uppercase, tracking-wide, font-bold. Use for Page Titles and Section Headers.
usage_rules.subheadings: JetBrains Mono, uppercase, tracking-widest, text-xs, text-muted-foreground. Use for labels like 'MISSION STATUS' or 'USER ID'.
usage_rules.body: Inter for readability in long paragraphs. JetBrains Mono for data values, tables, and dashboard metrics.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1). Active elements get 'payload-neon' border.
visual_enhancers.corners: Sharp (rounded-none) or Micro (rounded-sm). NO large rounded corners.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Glow effects instead of drop shadows. box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 255, 148, 0.3)
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grid background (20px x 20px) with 5% opacity lines.

layout_strategy.landing_page: MODE A: THE 'TETRIS' GRID. Asymmetrical, overlapping elements. Use 'lenis' for smooth scroll.
layout_strategy.dashboard: MODE B: THE 'CONTROL ROOM' GRID. Dense, data-heavy, 100% width/height utilization. No gaps between panels (or very small 1px gaps).
layout_strategy.spacing: Generous on Landing Page (p-24), Compact on Dashboard (p-4).
layout_strategy.container: Max-width 1400px for Landing. Full-width (100%) for Dashboard.

buttons.style: Rectangular, uppercase text, tracking-widest. Hover: Fill with Neon, Text becomes Black.

variants.primary: border border-payload-neon text-payload-neon hover:bg-payload-neon hover:text-black transition-all duration-300

cards.decoration: Add a 1px 'tech line' or corner marker in SVG absolute positioned.

inputs.style: bg-black border-b border-white/20 focus:border-payload-neon focus:ring-0 rounded-none px-0 placeholder:text-white/30 font-mono

hero_background.description: Cyberpunk door to unknown - use for Hero Section background with heavy overlay

auth_background.description: Deep space nebula - use for Login/Register page background

dashboard_abstract.description: Abstract purple lights - use for 'Mission' or 'Payload' card backgrounds

motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in with slight y-axis shift.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS FIRST: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js to include the custom colors (payload-bg, payload-neon, etc) and font families.
3. OVERRIDE SHADCN: Go into src/components/ui and remove 'rounded-md' from buttons, inputs, and cards. Force 'rounded-none' or 'rounded-sm'.
4. DARK MODE DEFAULT: Ensure the app forces dark mode. Do not implement a light mode toggle.
5. USE GRID LINES: In the dashboard, use borders to separate sections instead of whitespace (The 'Grid Borders' surface strategy).
6. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds, use solid deep black.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all numbers and data.
Always add a 'glow' effect to the primary CTA button.
Use 2-3x more padding in the Landing Page sections.
